'''Mara Junot''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Junot was born on May 8th, and she became a voice actress as an adult. Junot joined the cast of Pokémon during {{aniseries|HZ}}, voicing [[Orla]] from the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]].
